title: 3969. Valid Subarrays With Matching Sum Digits I

examples.explanation: The valid subarrays are: nums[0..0]: sum = 1 nums[0..1]: sum = 1 + 100 = 101 nums[1..2]: sum = 100 + 1 = 101 nums[2..2]: sum = 1 Thus, the answer is 4.
The only subarray is nums[0..0] with a sum of 1, which does not satisfy the conditions. Thus, the answer is 0.

hints: Enumerate all subarrays with two loops. Since nums.length <= 1500, checking all O(n2) subarrays is acceptable.

You can use prefix sums so the sum of any nums[l..r] can be computed in constant time. Alternatively, you can enumerate the starting index i, then extend the ending index j while maintaining the running sum of nums[i..j].
For each subarray sum, check whether its last digit is x, then repeatedly divide by 10 to get its first digit.
